quotes.quote: Hope is the worst of evils, for it prolongs the torments of man.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Fear is the mother of morality.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: The only cure for the malady of living is death.
quotes.author: Emil Cioran

quotes.quote: Existence is a brief crack of light between two eternities of darkness.
quotes.author: Vladimir Nabokov

quotes.quote: Life is a hospital where every patient desires to change beds.
quotes.author: Charles Baudelaire

quotes.quote: Optimism is a coward's way of avoiding the terrifying reality of existence.
quotes.author: Emil Cioran

quotes.quote: The only true freedom is found in the embrace of total destruction.
quotes.author: Mikhail Bakunin

quotes.quote: We are diseases of the earth, parasites feeding on a dying host.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Love is the most beautiful lie we invent to justify our suffering.

quotes.quote: The truth will not set you free; it will only strip away your delusions.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: You are nothing but a fleeting whisper in a universe that does not care.
quotes.author: H.P. Lovecraft

quotes.quote: The Devil's best trick was convincing you he didn't exist.
quotes.author: Charles Baudelaire

quotes.quote: Peace is merely the brief, fragile pause between the slaughter.

quotes.quote: Love is merely the instinct to survive, dressed up in poetry.

quotes.quote: Compassion is a weakness that drags the strong down into the mud with the weak.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: The light at the end of the tunnel is just the headlamp of an oncoming train.
quotes.author: Robert Lowell

quotes.quote: We crawl toward a grave dug for us the moment we took our first breath.
quotes.author: Emil Cioran

quotes.quote: To be born is a mistake. To live is a punishment. To die is a relief.
quotes.author: Emil Cioran

quotes.quote: Faith is the mind's refusal to accept the horror of its own existence.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.quote: We construct our own hells out of the ashes of our shattered dreams.
quotes.author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quotes.quote: Memory is a curse. It forces us to carry the rotting corpses of our past.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

quotes.quote: Happiness is an illusion designed to keep you marching to the grave.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: In the end, everything you love will rot, decay, and turn to dust.

quotes.quote: The human heart is a factory that produces nothing but endless suffering.

quotes.quote: Your suffering has no purpose. It is simply the toll you pay for existing.
quotes.author: Emil Cioran

quotes.quote: The heavens are empty, and the earth is nothing but a slaughterhouse.

quotes.quote: The only guarantee in this life is pain, and the only escape is nothingness.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Every smile is a mask trying to hide the unbearable weight of despair.
quotes.author: Soren Kierkegaard

quotes.quote: You are trapped in a decaying vessel, slowly waiting for the inevitable end.
quotes.author: H.P. Lovecraft

quotes.quote: We seek companionship because we are terrified of our own emptiness.
quotes.author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quotes.quote: No amount of prayer can silence the agonizing truth of our mortality.

quotes.quote: Life is a cruel joke, and humanity is the punchline.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: True beauty is the knowledge that all things will eventually be destroyed.
quotes.author: Marquis de Sade

quotes.quote: You cling to hope like a drowning man clings to an anchor.
quotes.author: Emil Cioran

quotes.quote: All joy is built entirely upon the unseen misery of others.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Tears are the natural penalties of pleasure.
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: We live alone, we die alone. Everything else is just an illusion.
quotes.author: George Orwell

quotes.quote: A single murder makes you a monster. A million makes you a hero.
quotes.author: Charlie Chaplin

quotes.quote: Sanity is a cozy lie we tell ourselves to ignore the screaming void.
quotes.author: H.P. Lovecraft

quotes.quote: There is no escape. You pay for the violence of your ancestors.

quotes.quote: Hell is not other people. Hell is yourself.

quotes.quote: Happiness is the most insidious prison.
quotes.author: Emil Cioran

quotes.quote: The only inborn error is the notion that we exist to be happy.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: I have no mouth. And I must scream.
quotes.author: Harlan Ellison

quotes.quote: The thought of suicide is a great consolation.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Existence is an illusion, with nothing to sustain it but our own terror.
quotes.author: Emil Cioran

quotes.quote: Cruelty is the gift humanity has given itself.
quotes.author: Hannibal Lecter

quotes.quote: Death is the only god who comes when you call.
quotes.author: Roger Zelazny

quotes.quote: Show me a hero, and I will write you a tragedy.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: Every step forward is made at the cost of mental and physical pain.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
